review_candidates.title: Lead Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Lead Network Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, operation, security and continual improvement of the firm’s network infrastructure across office, data centre, cloud and remote access environments. The role owns network standards, resilience, service performance, risk management, supplier coordination and the delivery of network-related change. Network Operations •        Lead the implementation, support and lifecycle management of network services across office, data centre, cloud connectivity, wireless and remote access environments. •        Maintain secure, resilient and scalable network services aligned to business requirements, client expectations and regulatory obligations. •        Support disaster recovery testing, failover validation and availability improvement for critical network services. •        Monitor network performance, identify risks, resolve complex incidents and drive continual service improvement. •        Maintain operational procedures, implementation plans and technical documentation to support controlled and repeatable delivery. •        Comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations, including the Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) Standards and Regulations and Principles.   Strategy and Architecture •        Shape and maintain the technical roadmap for network services, ensuring alignment with the firm’s technology strategy, security requirements and resilience objectives. •        Own network standards, reference architectures and design principles across office, data centre, cloud, wireless and secure access services. •        Provide architectural assurance for projects, office moves, cloud adoption and supplier-led changes, ensuring risks and operational impacts are understood. •        Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor roadmaps to improve automation, observability, resilience, security and operational efficiency.   Leadership •        Provide technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to network engineers, junior colleagues and wider IT teams. •        Work closely with Information Security, Security Operations, Cloud Operations, Service Delivery and Infrastructure teams to ensure network services remain secure, supportable and aligned to wider priorities. •        Support planning, prioritisation and budget input for network lifecycle, licensing, service improvement and project requirements.   Operational Excellence and Service Management •        Operate network services in line with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release and configuration management practices. •        Act as a senior escalation point for complex incidents, coordinating root cause analysis, corrective action and stakeholder communication. •        Maintain effective monitoring, alerting and reporting to identify service degradation, capacity constraints, security events and availability risks.   Security and Risk Management •        Embed security-by-design across network architecture, operations and project delivery. •        Support Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) capabilities for secure access to internet, SaaS, cloud and private applications. •        Partner with Information Security on risk management, audit readiness, vulnerability remediation and compliance requirements, including ISO 27001, GDPR and CIS Controls. •        Support network-related security incident investigation, containment, remediation and lessons learned. Stakeholder and Vendor Management   •        Act as a senior technical escalation point for network infrastructure issues, risks and decisions. •        Translate business requirements into secure, supportable and cost-effective network solutions. •        Manage technical engagement with network suppliers, managed service providers and service partners, including performance, escalation and delivery assurance. Key Skills and Experience Essential •        Significant hands-on experience in a senior or lead network engineering role within a complex enterprise environment. •        Deep knowledge of enterprise networking, including Layer 2/3, switching, routing, VLANs, segmentation, high availability, wireless and troubleshooting. •        Strong experience with Cisco enterprise technologies, including Catalyst, Nexus, Cisco ISE, RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X and access control policies. •        Proven experience with network security and secure access technologies, including Palo Alto, Fortinet FortiGate, Prisma Access, SD-WAN, SSE and SASE concepts. •        Required experience designing, implementing and supporting Microsoft Azure networking, including virtual networks, subnets, NSGs, route tables, UDRs, private DNS and hybrid connectivity. •        Experience supporting network resilience, high availability, disaster recovery testing, monitoring and observability across enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data centre and cloud services. •        Experience producing and maintaining HLDs, LLDs, standards, implementation plans and operational documentation. •        Solid understanding of IT service management disciplines, including incident, problem, change, release and configuration management. •        Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex networking principles clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. •        Experience with network automation, scripting, infrastructure as code or configuration management tooling.   Advantageous •        Relevant Cisco, security or cloud certifications, such as CCNA, CCNP, PCNSE, NSE or Microsoft Azure certifications. •        Experience maintaining, troubleshooting and supporting Wireless LAN Controllers and associated enterprise Wi-Fi networks. •        Experience configuring and maintaining Cisco 9800 Wireless LAN Controllers and/or Cisco Meraki wireless networking. •        Experience working in a professional services, legal or similarly regulated environment. •        Knowledge of LogicMonitor or Solarwinds monitoring and observability platforms   Person Specification •        Analytical, methodical and calm under pressure, with sound judgement when resolving complex technical issues. •        Proactive and ownership-focused, with the ability to prioritise competing demands and deliver work to agreed standards. •        Committed to continuous improvement, automation, knowledge sharing and self-development. •        Collaborative and service-focused, with strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. •        Professional and detail-oriented, with an appreciation of the standards expected in a client-focused professional services environment.   Competencies    •                   Working together        •           Integrity and respect         •                   Inclusive          •           Personal impact and growth •                   Driving high standards               •           Commercial mindset Client - centric   •           Responsible Business Hybrid working - We adopt a hybrid and flexible working approach, dependent on the requirements of the role and subject to manager approval.   For a detailed specification please download the job description in the documents section of this page. Clicking 'apply' will direct you to the application tracking system, hosted for us by Reach-ATS.com.

review_candidates.title: 网络工程师（中级/高级）
review_candidates.company: 沃尔玛(中国)投资有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 网络工程师 岗位职责 1. 网络日常运维与技术支持： 负责全国门店、仓库网络设备及线路的日常运维与故障排查，保障网络稳定运行，并按要求承担日常网络值班工作。 2. 网络项目建设与交付： 参与全国门店及仓库IT项目中网络部分的方案实施，执行具体的网络建设、设备上线与技术落地工作。 3. 招投标与技术测试执行： 参与全国网络设备与线路的定期招投标工作，负责执行新设备的POC测试，并协助输出招标技术要求。 4. 标准化配置执行： 按照统一网络配置标准，推动现有网络环境的规范化整理与配置落地。 5. 自动化脚本开发与执行： 编写并维护网络自动化脚本，配合管理平台实现对全国门店及仓库网络设备的批量配置与自动化运维。 6. 核心网络与线路维护： 负责门店、仓库出口网络线路及汇聚至总部核心网络设备的日常管理与维护。 7. 负责企业CUCM（Cisco Unified Communications Manager）语音系统的日常运维、监控、故障排查与性能优化，保障语音通信服务的稳定、安全与高质量运行。 任职要求 1. 计算机、通信或相关专业本科及以上学历优先，具备 5年以上 网络工程及运维经验，有大型连锁零售行业经验者优先。 2. 具备良好的英语听说读写能力，能够阅读英文技术文档及进行日常业务沟通者优先。 3. 熟练掌握TCP/IP协议栈，理解OSPF、BGP等动态路由协议及VLAN、STP等二三层交换技术。 4. 熟练掌握主流厂商（Cisco、华为、H3C等）路由器、交换机、无线控制器（AC）、无线AP的配置与排错。 5. 熟悉MPLS VPN、IPsec/SSL VPN、SD-WAN等广域网技术，具备跨地域网络运维能力。 6. 理解VoIP相关协议与技术（如SIP, H.323, MGCP, RTP/RTCP）。 7. 具备Python、Shell等脚本编写能力，能够运用脚本对网络设备进行批量配置与自动化巡检。

review_candidates.title: Power Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company GE Vernova is a leading global energy company dedicated to accelerating the transition to cleaner, more reliable, and affordable energy solutions. Committed to innovation and sustainability, GE Vernova focuses on developing cutting-edge technologies in power generation, electrification, and renewable energy. The company aims to help customers worldwide power economies while prioritizing safety, environmental responsibility, and operational excellence. With a rich history of technological advancement and a forward-looking approach, GE Vernova is at the forefront of shaping a sustainable energy future that benefits communities, industries, and the planet. About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Engineer to join our Electrical & Electronics team within GE Vernova’s Advanced Research division. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to the development and deployment of transformative electrical and grid technologies that support our strategic objectives in electrification and renewable energy. Your expertise will guide research initiatives, influence product roadmaps, and foster strategic collaborations with academic institutions and industry partners. This role offers the opportunity to lead disruptive technology programs from conception through to commercialization, impacting the future of energy systems globally. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product management, and executive leadership, to ensure that our technological advancements align with business goals and market needs. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a doctorate degree in Electrical Engineering with specialization in Power Systems, or a master’s degree with extensive industry experience. A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in electrical systems deployment, research, and development is required, along with proven leadership in managing large-scale projects and technical teams. Deep expertise in power system operation, control, protection, and market dynamics is essential. Hands-on experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, simulation software such as PSCAD, Matlab/Simulink, DigSilent, and programming skills in Python, C++, and Visual Studio are highly desirable. Candidates should demonstrate a successful track record of leading innovative research programs, securing funding through proposals, and translating ideas into market-ready products. Strong communication, collaboration, and strategic thinking skills will set candidates apart. Responsibilities As a Senior Engineer at GE Vernova, your responsibilities will include identifying and addressing electrical and grid technology needs in collaboration with various business units. You will lead research initiatives aimed at developing disruptive technologies, ensuring alignment with long-term strategic roadmaps. Your role involves building a robust portfolio of research programs that drive the electrification strategy, overseeing early-stage technology development, and maturing these technologies toward commercial deployment. You will coordinate with internal teams and external partners to demonstrate new technologies through lab testing and pilot projects, ensuring integration into product offerings. Additionally, you will contribute to the formulation of multi-year technology and product roadmaps, emphasizing safety, quality, and innovation. Providing technical leadership on emerging market trends and fostering strategic partnerships will be key to maintaining GE Vernova’s competitive edge. You will also support the integration of related fields such as power electronics, AI/machine learning, and cybersecurity into the broader research agenda. Benefits GE Vernova offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal and professional growth. Our compensation and benefits programs are tailored to reward high performance and to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We promote a healthy work-life balance through various wellness initiatives and flexible work arrangements. The company invests in your ongoing development with opportunities for continuous learning, training, and career advancement. As part of our commitment to fostering an inclusive environment, we provide resources and support systems that promote diversity, equity, and inclusion. By joining GE Vernova, you become part of a global organization dedicated to making a positive impact on the world’s energy landscape while supporting your individual aspirations and well-being. Equal Opportunity GE Vernova is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure fairness and equal opportunity for all qualified candidates. We believe that diverse teams foster innovation and drive better solutions, and we are dedicated to providing a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their best.

review_candidates.title: Ingeniero de Transformación Digital e Inteligencia Artificial
review_candidates.description: Sobre el proyecto En San José Tropical Fruit, empresa mexicana dedicada al empaque y exportación de limón persa a Estados Unidos, estamos iniciando un proyecto estratégico para transformar la manera en que administramos y utilizamos la información de nuestra empresa. Nuestro objetivo es construir una plataforma empresarial donde la información de áreas como Administración, Contabilidad, Logística, Producción, Calidad y Exportaciones esté centralizada, organizada, segura y disponible para búsquedas inteligentes mediante herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial. El reto Buscamos una persona con iniciativa y capacidad técnica para ayudarnos a diseñar e implementar desde cero nuestra plataforma de gestión documental y conocimiento, utilizando principalmente el ecosistema Microsoft. No buscamos solamente a alguien que administre sistemas existentes. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute construir, automatizar y resolver problemas. Principales responsabilidades * Diseñar la arquitectura documental de la empresa en Microsoft 365, SharePoint y OneDrive. * Crear bibliotecas, estructuras, metadatos, nomenclaturas y políticas de acceso. * Establecer permisos, seguridad y control de versiones. * Migrar y organizar información actualmente distribuida entre diferentes áreas y computadoras. * Diseñar un sistema que permita localizar rápidamente documentos por cliente, proveedor, fecha, embarque, pedimento, factura, área u otros criterios. * Automatizar procesos y aprobaciones utilizando Power Automate. * Desarrollar soluciones con Power Apps cuando generen valor. * Apoyar integraciones con Microsoft Dynamics y otras plataformas. * Implementar herramientas de IA / Microsoft Copilot para consultar y aprovechar el conocimiento interno de la empresa. * Capacitar a usuarios y documentar procesos y mejores prácticas. * Identificar nuevas oportunidades de automatización y transformación digital. Perfil que buscamos * Ingeniería en Sistemas, Computer Science, Tecnologías de Información, Software o carrera afín. * Desde recién egresado con experiencia práctica relevante hasta aproximadamente 5 años de experiencia. * Conocimiento práctico de Microsoft 365 y SharePoint. * Experiencia o familiaridad con Power Automate. * Capacidad para entender procesos de negocio y convertirlos en soluciones tecnológicas. * Persona organizada, autónoma, proactiva y con facilidad para trabajar con usuarios no técnicos. * Inglés técnico. Será un plus tener experiencia con: Power Apps | Power BI | Microsoft Copilot | Azure | SQL | Python | Dynamics | Seguridad Microsoft 365 | Migraciones documentales Modalidad La posición será principalmente remota desde México, aunque será importante tener disponibilidad para realizar visitas ocasionales a nuestra operación y conocer directamente los procesos de las diferentes áreas. El proyecto comenzará bajo un esquema flexible, con posibilidad real de continuidad y crecimiento de acuerdo con los resultados y las necesidades de la empresa. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Un proyecto con impacto directo en toda la organización y la oportunidad de participar prácticamente desde cero en la construcción de la plataforma digital de una empresa en crecimiento. La persona seleccionada tendrá contacto directo con la Dirección y libertad para proponer, diseñar e implementar soluciones. Existe posibilidad de evolucionar hacia una posición de mayor responsabilidad en Transformación Digital, Automatización e Inteligencia Artificial. Compensación competitiva de acuerdo con experiencia. Proceso de selección Los candidatos finalistas realizarán un ejercicio práctico breve. Nos interesa conocer no solamente qué herramientas manejas, sino cómo piensas y cómo resolverías un problema real de organización, automatización y búsqueda de información empresarial. No buscamos solamente cubrir una vacante. Buscamos a la persona que nos ayude a construir y evolucionar la plataforma digital de conocimiento de San José.

Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. IT SUPPORT TECHNICIAN, VIP SUPPORT SpaceX is looking for an experienced IT Support Technician with strong knowledge and experience in world class IT service delivery. Candidates must have experience working in organizations capable of meeting the demanding needs of “high caliber engineers”, supporting critical operations such as launch and mission operations, and 24x7 manufacturing operations. This team delivers the complete life cycle of IT services for the staff at SpaceX, from onboarding and setup, to upgrade, installation, troubleshooting, repair, and replacement of hardware and software solutions, asset recovery, and protection. This team also has architectural responsibilities in the areas of end-user computer infrastructure, printing, and conference room technologies. The person in this position must have strong overall IT technical skills, while also having excellent customer service/interaction skills and superior organizational skills. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast paced and challenging environment. They should be a self-starter and have excellent motivation, leadership, and ingenuity to excel at this position. Responsibilities Provide 1st, 2nd, and 3rd tier support to SpaceX employees. Manage on site inventory and the total lifecycle of IT assets. Procure, configure and deploy computer hardware and mobile cellular devices. Troubleshoot software and hardware issues, in person and remotely. Configure and troubleshoot desktop, label and large multifunction printers. Network support and troubleshooting, from device connectivity to VLAN configuration. Configure non-traditional network attached devices (production, metrology and test machines) and interface with SpaceX infrastructure. Develop new workflows and solutions, working directly with IT engineering groups and other internal/external resources to resolve complex issues. Support AV/VC solutions locally and globally to support in-region teams. Support events around the SpaceX offices from an AV (audio/visual) standpoint, and occasional out-of-hours event support. Write instructional documentation and convey highly technical ideas in terms that non-technical people can understand. Basic Qualifications High school diploma or equivalency certificate. 1+ years of professional experience building, deploying and troubleshooting computer systems, hardware, printers, software, and IP networks within an enterprise environment. 1+ years of professional experience in AV (audio/visual) events support. Experience supporting Microsoft technologies. Preferred Skills And Experience Experience supporting Mac iOS and Linux environments. Technical certifications (i.e. A+, Network+, MCSE). Working knowledge of audio-visual equipment. Experience working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities. Able to work independently while maintaining patience with the constant interruptions. Due to the high visibility of this position, excellent written, verbal and phone communications skills. Additional Requirements Must be physically fit enough to regularly lift up to 25 lbs. for duties (i.e. delivering computers, unpacking and rack-mounting equipment). Must have valid driver's license. Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed. Compensation And Benefits Pay Range: Level 1: $29.00 - $35.00 Level 2: $34.00 - $40.00 Level 3: $38.00 - $45.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. review_candidates.title: Printed Circuit Board Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Automaze Innovations is a technology services company focused on delivering high-quality IT solutions that improve efficiency and drive innovation for businesses. The team provides custom software development, strategic IT consulting, cloud services, cybersecurity, managed IT services, and data analytics. With a strong customer-centric approach, Automaze Innovations tailors solutions to the unique requirements of each client. Applicants joining Automaze Innovations can expect to work in a professional environment that values technical excellence, collaboration, and long-term partnerships. Role Description The Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Surat. This role involves designing and developing PCB layouts from concept to production, including schematic capture, component selection, and optimization for manufacturability and reliability. The PCB Design Engineer will collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to validate designs, perform design reviews, and resolve technical issues. Daily responsibilities include creating and maintaining design documentation, running simulations and signal integrity checks, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and supporting testing and debugging of prototypes. Qualifications Circuit Design and Electrical Engineering skills for developing robust PCB schematics and system-level architectures. Analog design expertise for handling power supplies, amplifiers, and mixed-signal circuits. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位：储能项目投资分析师/经理 地点：苏州，中国 职位概述 揽海新能源(Mars Renewable)是一家面向欧洲市场的储能(BESS)企业，业务正向资产端开发(asset origination)延伸。作为储能项目投资分析师，你将是公司海外储能项目投资决策的量化核心——搭建和运营项目财务模型，评估欧洲各国储能项目的收益与风险(电价、辅助服务、容量机制、政策监管)，支持项目筛选、尽职调查与投资决策全流程。你的分析将直接决定公司在欧洲数亿级资产的投向，与业务开发、法务、交付团队紧密协作，并接触一线欧洲市场数据。 职责 一、财务建模与收益测算 搭建并维护储能项目全生命周期财务模型(DCF / IRR / NPV / 回收期)，涵盖收入侧(能量套利、辅助服务、容量费用、PPA)与成本侧(CAPEX / OPEX / 税费 / 融资成本) 对电价曲线、循环次数、衰减率、辅助服务价格等关键变量进行敏感性分析与情景模拟 二、市场与政策研究 跟踪欧洲主要市场(英、德、意、西、荷等)的电价走势、批发电价与平衡机制、容量市场/容量费政策及各国储能收入机制演变 研究各国监管框架对储能资产收益的影响(电网费率、双重收费豁免、拍卖机制等)，输出市场进入优先级建议 三、项目筛选与尽调支持 对潜在储能项目/资产标的进行初步筛选与收益初评，输出投资评级建议 支持项目尽职调查：审阅收入合同(PPA / 容量协议 / 辅助服务合同)、技术参数(可用率、循环寿命)、并网与许可条件，识别收益实现风险 四、投资决策支持 撰写投资分析报告、投资备忘录与董事会汇报材料，清晰呈现收益逻辑、风险与缓释措施 参与投资决策会议，对模型假设与测算结果进行答辩 五、投后跟踪与模型校准 跟踪已投项目实际运行数据与收益兑现情况，校准模型假设，输出偏差分析与经验沉淀 支持资产退出(转让)时的估值测算与买方沟通材料 六、其他 完成公司安排的其他工作 任职要求 硬性门槛(必需) 本科及以上学历，金融、经济、电气工程、能源、数学等相关专业 3–6 年投资分析、项目融资、财务建模或能源行业研究经验 能独立从零搭建项目财务模型(Excel 高级运用：情景/敏感性/蒙特卡洛加分) 熟悉项目投资评价指标体系(IRR / NPV / DSCR / 回收期)及其金融逻辑 专业能力 理解电力市场基本逻辑：批发电价、峰谷价差、辅助服务、容量机制；对至少一个欧洲电力市场有认知 具备较强的数据获取与处理能力(电价数据、市场报告、公开数据库) 报告撰写与呈现能力强，能把复杂测算讲给非金融背景的管理层听懂 素质要求 好奇心强、自驱，愿意深挖市场与政策细节 严谨、对数字敏感，敢于挑战业务端的乐观假设 能适应多任务并行与快节奏决策环境 加分项 有欧洲电力市场/储能项目投资分析经验(尤其在英国、德国、意大利市场) 熟悉储能技术参数与运行逻辑(循环寿命、效率、衰减)对收益的影响，或有 BESS 技术背景 有投行、基金、咨询(能源组)或电力公司战略/投资部门背景 会使用 Python / PLEXOS / Envision 等分析工具，或有蒙特卡洛/优化建模经验 英语可作为工作语言(阅读欧洲市场报告、与外部顾问沟通)

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 1. 媒体资源整合与对接（核心）：负责商场全媒体渠道搭建与维护，包含本地自媒体、短视频达人、探店博主、社群媒体、线下广告媒体、主流本地生活媒体等资源的开拓、洽谈、签约及日常维护；具备乙方对接思维，可高效统筹外部媒体资源，把控合作质量与落地效果。 2. 营销活动媒体落地：配合商场月度、季度、节庆、店庆等全品类营销活动，制定专属媒体传播方案，统筹媒体宣发、达人探店、短视频种草、直播推广等全流程落地，跟进素材拍摄、剪辑、发布及曝光追踪，保障活动传播声量与客流转化。 3. 内容宣发与账号运营：负责商场官方抖音、小红书、视频号、公众号等新媒体账号日常运营，包含内容策划、文案撰写、选题输出、素材统筹、更新发布及粉丝维护，打造商场本地流量阵地，提升项目线上知名度。 4. 媒体投放与效果复盘：负责媒体合作预算管控、投放排期规划、合作合同对接，全程把控投放落地过程；活动结束后完成数据复盘（曝光、播放、互动、引流、到店转化），输出媒体投放复盘报告，优化后续传播策略。 5. 舆情监控与品牌维护：实时监控本地平台关于商场的舆情信息，及时处理负面评价、客诉舆论，维护商场品牌口碑；挖掘优质传播热点，结合商场业态、商户活动打造差异化宣传内容。 6. 跨部门协同配合：联动招商、营运部门，配合商户开业、品牌推广、业态升级等节点开展媒体宣传工作，助力商户引流、提升商场整体经营氛围与业绩。 任职要求 1. 经验优先：优先录用有广告公司、传媒公司、新媒体乙方服务公司从业经验者，有商业综合体、购物中心、本地生活行业媒体对接、营销宣发经验者优先，熟悉重庆本地媒体、达人资源及本地流量玩法。 2. 市场营销、新闻传播、新媒体、广告学等相关专业优先，1-3年媒体策划、新媒体运营、品牌宣发相关工作经验。 3. 具备独立的媒体方案策划、内容选题、文案撰写能力，熟悉抖音、小红书、视频号等主流新媒体平台规则，懂短视频内容创作、流量逻辑和达人合作模式。 4. 拥有乙方服务思维，擅长对外沟通谈判、资源整合、多方对接，抗压能力强，落地执行高效，能精准把控项目节点，高效完成各类媒体宣发落地工作。 5. 具备基础的数据复盘能力，可通过传播数据优化宣传策略，对商业体营销、流量引流、用户转化有清晰认知。 6. 工作积极主动、责任心强，具备良好的团队协作能力。

review_candidates.description: Venha construir a sua história no Grupo FAN! Com mais de 60 anos de trajetória, o Grupo FAN é sinônimo de excelência, solidez e compromisso. Nossa história é movida por dedicação, inovação e pelo propósito de fazer a diferença não só no mercado, mas na vida das pessoas. Somos uma organização de múltiplos segmentos, com atuação relevante em combustíveis, serviços financeiros, construção civil e produção de alimentos, sempre com foco em crescimento sustentável e valor para a sociedade. Conheça mais sobre o Grupo FAN em https://grupofan.com PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES: Supervisão de Equipe: Supervisionar, orientar e acompanhar a equipe de qualidade do produto nas rotinas diárias de controle de qualidade nas obras. Acompanhamento Preventivo: Atuar diretamente no canteiro de obras, acompanhando a execução dos serviços em tempo real para prevenir desvios e assegurar o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Conferência de Serviços: Apoiar e supervisionar a liberação e conferência dos serviços executados, verificando conformidade com projetos, procedimentos e especificações técnicas. Monitoramento de Indicadores: Acompanhar indicadores e registros da área de qualidade, contribuindo com análises e ações de melhoria contínua. Conformidade Técnica: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, procedimentos internos e diretrizes da construtora nas frentes de trabalho. Atuação na Solução de Problemas : Identificar de forma antecipada possíveis falhas construtivas, apoiando a equipe de produção na correção dos métodos executivos sempre que necessário. Interface com a Obra : Manter alinhamento constante com engenheiros, encarregados e mestres de obras para assegurar a execução correta dos serviços e o fluxo das inspeções de qualidade. Treinamento de Qualidade: Realizar treinamentos com as equipes da empresa sobre os procedimentos de execução de serviços adotados pela empresa, com foco na padronização das atividades, no cumprimento dos requisitos de qualidade e na melhoria contínua dos processos. Revisão de Especificações Técnicas de Serviço: Revisar, em conjunto com o setor do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, as Especificações Técnicas de Serviço (ETS), considerando as oportunidades de melhoria identificadas ao longo da execução dos processos REQUISITOS DA VAGA Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil (com registro ativo no CREA). Experiência comprovada e sólida atuação em obras (produção e/ou qualidade). Conhecimento técnico sobre método construtivo Parede de Concreto. Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas técnicos complexos. Desejáveis (Diferenciais): Pós-graduação ou especialização em Patologia das Construções. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis aplicadas à construção (Lean Construction) Formação Acadêmica Não informado Salário A combinar Cargo Outros Empresa Grupo fan Distribuição de combustíveis gasosos por redes urbanas Ramo Petroquímico/ Petróleo (HB)

review_candidates.title: Senior Project Accountant, Generation Development
review_candidates.description: About us: Founded in 1990, LS Power is a premier development, investment, and operating company focused on the North American power and energy infrastructure sector, with leading platforms across generation, transmission and energy expansion solutions. Since inception, LS Power has developed or acquired 50,000 MW of power generation, including utility-scale solar, wind, hydro, battery energy storage, and natural gas-fired facilities. Through its transmission business, LS Power Grid, the company built and operates 780+ miles of high-voltage transmission and 7 transmission utilities and has another 375+ miles currently in construction or development. LS Power actively invests in and scales businesses that are meeting the growing needs of the energy expansion, including electric vehicle charging, demand response, microgrids, renewable fuels and waste-to-energy platforms. Over the years, LS Power has raised more than $89 billion in debt and equity capital to support North American infrastructure. Our Purpose, Mission, & Values: Our Purpose is to solve complex energy problems that improve the world Our Mission is to make lives better by developing a cleaner and more reliable energy ecosystem Our Values are the willingness to participate in and help strengthen our culture of integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, and Taking Ownership Our People create value and are our Most Valuable asset. We take our values of Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork and Taking Ownership seriously and ask candidates to think about how they can help us further enhance our culture with their specific skillsets, capabilities and experiences. Benefits We provide our team the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and continue in their career growth. We are committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits that include 100% employer paid premium healthcare, paid parental leave and more. Compensation The salary for this role is $82,000 - $100,000. This is the range that we in good faith anticipate relying on when setting wages for this position. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and this range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in New Jersey. This salary range may also be modified in the future. About the Role: LS Power is seeking a Senior Project Accountant to join its growing Generation Development Accounting team. As the generation development portfolio expands, so does the volume, complexity, and financial risk of capital project activity. This role maintains the financial visibility and control senior management requires as projects move from early-stage development through construction and into service. The Senior Project Accountant is the primary financial partner to project management and development teams, ensuring every dollar of capital spend is accurately tracked, properly coded, and clearly reported across the project lifecycle. The role goes beyond recording transactions. It means flagging budget variances before they escalate, challenging cost classifications before they hit the ledger, and delivering the financial discipline that supports confident decision-making at the executive level. Deep proficiency in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Management module and a demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered tools to streamline reporting and surface insights faster are essential. Responsibilities What You Will Do Project Accounting & Month-End Close Own end-to-end project accounting for active generation development projects, serving as the primary contact for project cost information for internal and external stakeholders. Maintain project cost structures in the D365 Project Management module so that work orders, purchase orders, and contract commitments are reflected accurately and in real time. Coordinate with AP, procurement, and project development teams on accurate capital coding and timely cost capture in the general ledger, and resolve coding disputes to prevent month-end backlogs. Review requisitions and purchase orders through the approval workflow, confirming project coding and budget alignment before commitments are released. Review construction contract invoices against approved budgets, support the project team in maintaining change order logs, and track retainage balances across all active generation development projects. Proactively identify budget variances at the contract and work order level and communicate findings to project managers and senior management before variances compound. Manage month-end close, including recording actuals, determining accruals, posting audit-ready journal entries, and reconciling construction-in-progress (CWIP), AP accrual, and retainage balances. Monitor CWIP balances with project managers and fixed asset accounting to ensure timely plant-in-service transfers, on-schedule asset transfer packages, and proper cost componentization and classification at project completion. Support the broader accounting team with audit requests, special projects, and process improvement initiatives as they arise. Cash Flow Management & Financial Reporting Assist with monthly cash forecasting, maintaining a rolling 12-month forecast reflecting current project schedules, contract commitments, and funding requirements. Coordinate with project managers, treasury, and senior management to align cash forecasts with milestones and capital call schedules so funding precedes major expenditures. Monitor cash positions across project entities, prepare monthly cash summaries with variance explanations, and flag cash flow risk such as overruns, accelerated spend, or delayed recoveries well before liquidity is impacted. Build and maintain the monthly project spend report for leadership and investors using D365 data and AI-powered reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Copilot), with templates that pull cost data automatically and reduce manual preparation time. Tailor report formats and narratives to the audience, from executive dashboards to investor reporting packages that meet contractual requirements. Support budget preparation and monthly variance analysis, developing bottom-up capital budgets with project managers and preparing explanations that distinguish timing differences from scope changes and true overruns. Complete monthly and quarterly reporting required by individual project agreements, including investor reports, lender compliance packages, and project-level financial statements. Assist with quarterly and annual financial statement preparation and the annual audit, including audit schedules, auditor inquiries, and audit-ready project files maintained year-round. Support the annual capital budget process, coordinating with project managers to compile and review capital project budgets. Project Controls & Financial Integrity Act as the primary point of accountability for the accuracy of project cost data in D365, ensuring management reporting, investor reporting, and financial statements all draw from a single, reliable source of truth. Maintain and enforce project cost coding standards in D365 to prevent misclassification of operating costs as capital expenditures (or vice versa), and maintain a self-serve coding reference guide for project managers and AP staff. Conduct periodic audits of project cost transactions to identify miscoded items, duplicate charges, or unapproved commitments, and work with the relevant teams to resolve and prevent recurrence. Establish month-end review checklists and project close-out procedures that confirm all costs are captured, coded, and reconciled before reports are issued. Escalate control issues such as budget overruns, unauthorized commitments, or unusual cost patterns, and prepare a monthly project controls summary of open issues, corrective actions, and emerging risks. Support the tax teams and external tax advisors with project cost schedules, asset classification detail, and cost basis documentation segregated by asset type, jurisdiction, and tax treatment. Contribute to process improvement, documenting current-state processes and developing D365 workflows, automated controls, and reporting enhancements that increase efficiency and reduce error risk. Qualifications We Want You On Our Team Because You... Have strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting practices as applied to capital project and construction accounting, including cost capitalization, CWIP, and asset classification. Are proficient in Microsoft Dynamics 365, with the ability to navigate the Project Management module and extract, analyze, and report on project cost data with minimal support. Are familiar with procurement and payment management software, preferably D365 Procurement & Sourcing and IBM Maximo (others considered), including a solid understanding of requisition and purchase order approval workflows and how POs and invoices flow into the project ledger. Are comfortable using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Power BI to build spending reports, automate variance analysis, and present financial data to technical and non-technical audiences. Have strong Microsoft Excel skills, including modeling, pivot tables, and large data set management; Power Query and Fabric experience is a plus. Can manage multiple active projects simultaneously, meeting recurring deadlines while maintaining the attention to detail accurate reporting requires. Bring exceptional analytical and reasoning ability, with strong quantitative skills and the instinct to dig into variances and understand the “why” behind the numbers. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to present project financial status in management meetings, investor calls, and audit settings. Take a collaborative approach that builds strong relationships with project managers, AP, treasury, tax, and senior leadership, translating complex financial data into clear, actionable insight. Have a strong sense of ownership, surfacing issues before they escalate and operating with the integrity and professionalism LS Power's investors and partners expect. Ideally, You Have Bachelor's degree in Accounting; a master's degree or CPA designation is a plus. Minimum of four years of accounting experience, with meaningful exposure to capital project or construction accounting in an energy, power generation, or capital-intensive industry. Experience managing project accounting in a multi-entity environment with active capital development programs. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Project Management module) or a comparable ERP/project accounting system; configuring or maintaining project cost structures is a plus. Demonstrated experience with budget preparation, variance analysis, and cash flow forecasting for capital projects, and preparing financial reports for lenders and senior management

review_candidates.title: SVP, Finance (Infrastructure Construction)
review_candidates.description: The Senior Vice President of Finance serves as the strategic financial leader for the Infrastructure business, driving financial performance, governance, and long-term growth across a diverse portfolio of operations. Reporting to the CE&I CFO, with a matrix relationship to the Infrastructure EVP, this role leads the finance organization through a team of VP-level leaders and provides executive oversight of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, accounting operations, reporting, and compliance. As a trusted business partner to senior leadership, the SVP plays a critical role in shaping strategy, optimizing performance, and supporting disciplined growth. Location: This role offers location flexibility and may be based anywhere within the Continental United States. Travel: Up to 50% travel is required to provide on-site leadership, strengthen business partnerships, and support operations across a geographically diverse Infrastructure organization. Company Overview MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates more than $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our operating groups: Renewables, Industrial, Infrastructure and General Building. Our Renewables expertise includes solar, wind, energy storage, aftermarket services, substations and switchyards. Our Industrial expertise includes manufacturing, mining and mineral processing, power plants, conventional power generation, alternative fuel generation and other innovative solutions. In Infrastructure, we specialize in electrical, environmental, highways, roads and bridges, aggregate mining, ports and terminals, rail, pump and lift stations, water transmission and pipelines, water and wastewater treatment plants, and stormwater. Our General Building expertise includes airports, seaport terminals, sports and entertainment, pre-engineered metal buildings, and data centers. MasTec is a minority‑owned Fortune 500 construction company with more than 90 years of industry experience. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we deliver complex infrastructure projects across the country. Safety and sustainability are core to how we operate. MasTec is proudly ranked by Engineering News‑Record as #1 in Power, #16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, and #13 Transportation Contractor. The Clean Energy & Infrastructure Group comprises the following market sectors and operating companies: Renewables: IEA Constructors, Wanzek Construction, White Construction; Industrial: Phoenix Industrial, MasTec Industrial; Infrastructure: American Civil Constructors West Coast, Cash Construction, FNF Construction, MasTec Civil, McKee Utility Contractors, Precision Aggregate Products, Ragnar Benson Construction, Saiia Construction, William Charles Construction, William Charles Electric; General Building: Lemartec, NV2A. Responsibilities Strategic & Executive Leadership Serve as a core member of the CE&I finance leadership team. Participate in I&I Group strategy development and execution. Provide financial insights to drive disciplined capital allocation and business performance. Partner closely with operational leaders to improve financial transparency and accountability. Financial Management & Reporting Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, forecasting, and operating reviews. Oversee timely and accurate internal and external financial reporting. Ensure proper implementation of accounting policies and evolving internal controls. Maintain compliance with SOX and technical accounting standards. Oversee revenue recognition processes, particularly percentage-of-completion accounting for construction contracts. Project Controls & Risk Management Drive rigorous project financial management and risk mitigation processes. Enhance visibility into job-level profitability, cost controls, and margin performance. Support bid reviews and pricing decisions to improve win quality and risk-adjusted returns. Finance Operations & Transformation Lead finance operations across Infrastrtucture, focusing on process redesign and continuous improvement. Evaluate and deploy ERP systems and business enablement software solutions. Implement scalable systems and controls suitable for a rapidly expanding platform. Oversee integration of finance teams, systems, and processes following acquisitions. Talent & Organizational Development Develop strategic talent planning initiatives in partnership with HR. Mentor and coach high-performing finance leaders across business units. Build strong succession plans across all key finance roles. Foster a culture of integrity, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement. In The First 12 Months, The Successful Candidate Will Establish credibility with Infrastructure operational leaders and CE&I executive leadership. Develop a comprehensive understanding of project economics, systems, and reporting structures. Identify and prioritize critical finance transformation and integration initiatives. Improve forecasting reliability and project margin visibility. Strengthen internal controls and reporting consistency across legacy platforms. Provide leadership specific to change management on processes and ERP consolidation. Elevate talent capabilities and build a cohesive finance organization across acquired entities. Qualifications Work Experience and Education 10+ years of senior financial management experience in a large, geographically dispersed Infrastructure EPC or industrial organization. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business CPA or CA designation preferred Experience within a large, publicly traded organization strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Take reasonable care of your own and others’ health and safety and of those who may be affected by the day-to-day delivery of this role by taking personal responsibility for working toward the Company’s Zero Injury principles Demonstrated success leading high-performing finance teams in complex, publicly traded and growth-oriented environments. Experience overseeing Joint Venture operations, project-based accounting, and percentage-of-completion revenue recognition. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. What do we offer? review_candidates.title: 运营经理/总监
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 一、岗位职责 1. 经营计划与目标管理 主导公司年度/季度/月度经营计划、预算及KPI体系的制定、分解与落地； 建立计划跟踪机制，定期复盘经营指标完成情况，识别偏差并推动纠偏； 统筹各部门资源排布，确保战略目标在营销端和交付端同步对齐。 2. 营销全周期运营管理（市场 → 线索 → 商机 → 成交） 统筹营销体系的运营节奏，覆盖市场策划、品牌推广、线索获取、商机培育、投标支持、合同签订等全链路； 建立营销漏斗数据监控体系，跟踪线索转化率、商机推进效率、成交周期等核心指标； 协同市场、销售部门优化获客策略与销售流程，推动销售目标达成； 组织重大营销项目的统筹管理（如行业展会、大客户攻坚、新品发布等），确保关键节点按期交付。 3. 交付全周期运营管理（立项 → 实施 → 验收 → 回款 → 客户成功） 统筹交付体系运营，覆盖项目启动、方案实施、里程碑管控、客户验收、回款跟进、售后服务等全生命周期； 建立交付项目进度跟踪机制，定期输出项目健康度报告，预警延期、成本超支、质量偏差等风险； 推动交付标准化建设，优化项目交付流程、SOP及工具模板，提升交付效率与客户满意度； 协同交付、技术、供应链等部门，解决项目推进中的资源瓶颈与跨部门协作问题； 跟踪项目回款节点，推动应收账款按期回收，保障现金流健康。 4. 全公司AR项跟进与会议决议闭环 建立公司级AR（Action Item）管理机制，统筹各部门待办事项的收集、分配、跟踪与闭环验收； 负责公司各类经营会议（如经营分析会、项目协调会、专题复盘会）的决议事项跟进，确保决议落地执行； 定期输出AR执行进度报告，对逾期事项进行预警并推动责任部门整改； 推动公司执行力文化建设，确保"事事有回音、件件有着落"。 5. 项目进度统筹与风险管控 建立公司级项目管理体系（PMO），对重点营销项目和交付项目实行统一立项、分级管控； 组织项目例会、专题协调会及复盘会，确保信息透明、问题闭环、经验沉淀； 识别项目全周期中的关键风险，制定应对预案并推动落地。 6. 数据运营与流程优化 搭建覆盖"营销-交付"全链路的数据看板，实现经营数据可视化； 定期输出运营分析报告，为管理层提供决策支持； 梳理并优化LTC（Lead to Cash）核心业务流程，识别低效环节并推动改进，提升端到端运营效率。 二、任职要求 基本条件 学历要求：一类本科及以上学历，硕士优先； 专业背景：工商管理、项目管理、市场营销、经济学、理工科等相关专业； 工作经验： 运营经理：5年以上运营/项目管理经验，具备营销或交付端运营管理背景； 运营总监：8年以上经验，3年以上团队管理经验，有完整"营销+交付"双端运营操盘经历。 核心能力 全周期运营能力：熟悉B2B/解决方案型业务的营销全周期（获客→成交）和交付全周期（实施→回款→客户成功），有LTC流程管理经验优先； 计划与项目管理能力：精通经营计划编制与落地，熟悉PMBOK/敏捷等项目管理方法论，持有PMP认证者优先； AR跟进与执行力：具备公司级待办事项和会议决议的跟踪闭环经验，推动力强，能确保组织执行力落地； 进度管控能力：具备较强的项目跟踪、风险识别与问题解决能力，能推动复杂项目按期交付并回款； 数据驱动意识：具备经营数据分析能力，熟练使用项目管理工具（如Jira、飞书项目、Teambition）及数据分析工具； 跨部门协同能力：优秀的沟通协调能力，能有效整合市场、销售、交付、技术、财务等多方资源； 抗压与执行力：目标导向，责任心强，能在多线程高压环境下推动结果达成。

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 独立作战的顾问式销售岗，城市机构业绩的中坚力量。面向成长型出海企业与高净值个人客户，独立完成“获客—诊断—方案组织—成交—交付对接—续费经营”全周期；在标准化产品之外，能够销售跨境架构、跨境财税、私人税务、移民税务规划等中型顾问项目。 一、核心职责 1、独立获客：通过自有渠道与转介绍独立开发出海企业客户与高净值客户，完成年度创收指标； 2、需求诊断与方案组织：诊断客户在跨境架构、税务合规、身份规划、海外投融资等方面的需求，联动后台律师、会计师、持牌顾问输出方案，并主导商务谈判与签约； 3、中型项目统筹：主导ODI/FDI、红筹/VIE前期架构、跨境财税合规、移民前后税务规划等中型项目的商务全流程，协调交付团队保障落地； 4、渠道经营：在责任区域内建立并维护3–5个稳定获客渠道（银行、券商、律所、会计师事务所、移民公司、商协会），形成月度转介绍机制； 5、客户经营：负责客户全生命周期经营，提升续费率、复购率与转介绍率； 6、市场洞察：收集区域市场与竞品动态，向机构负责人与集团反馈产品化建议。 二、任职要求 1、本科及以上学历，商科、法学、财税类专业优先； 2、2–5年银行（对公或私行客户经理）、三方财富管理、证券、保险经纪、离岸或企业服务机构等销售经验； 3、有可验证的历史销售业绩（AUM、保费、创收、客户数等）； 4、具备顾问式销售能力，能独立完成需求诊断、方案讲解与商务谈判； 5、理解跨境商务基本概念（ODI、红筹架构、CRS等），入职3个月内通过集团产品认证； 6、自驱力强，适应高频拜访与业绩考核。 三、优先条件 1、外资银行（汇丰、渣打等）或股份制银行私行、对公客户经理，或三方财富（宜信、恒天、新湖等）绩优理财师； 2、离岸服务机构、移民公司、国际会计师事务所、律所市场或客户岗从业经历； 3、持有证券、基金、保险从业资格，AFP/CFP、法律职业资格等证书； 4、有可迁移的本地渠道资源（银行、商会、行业协会）； 四、薪酬架构与员工福利 多元薪酬 包括基本工资、岗位津贴、职位补贴、业绩提成、年终奖金及年度调薪。参与研究或撰写文章另享稿酬。 社会保障与假期 五险一金、双休、法定节假日；另有春节、远途及生日带薪假期等。 职业发展 员工可灵活选择管理（M）或专业（P）发展通道，两者互通，根据个人能力及工作表现参与晋升考核，获得发展机会。 培训与成长 提供系统化内部培训及跨区域学习机会，助力员工持续提升专业能力。 企业文化福利 定期发放节日礼品，组织团队建设及部门团建活动，营造积极的工作氛围。

review_candidates.title: 私域运营主管

This is a client-facing role first . You’ll work directly with clients to understand their needs, solve problems, and help them get the most out of their ERP environment. Strong functional expertise is important, but so is the ability to communicate clearly, build trust, and navigate conversations with both business and executive stakeholders. Required skills: Client communication: You’re comfortable leading status calls, presenting findings, discussing recommendations, and managing escalations with professionalism and composure. You can communicate confidently with clients while keeping conversations focused and productive. Technical communication: You’re able to take technical concepts such as configurations, integrations, and system behavior and explain them in clear, straightforward language that makes sense to business and executive audiences. Consulting / IT services experience: You’ve built your career within an IT services company, systems integrator, ERP vendor, or consulting firm (e.g., Accenture, NTT Data, Wipro, Infosys, or an ERP-partner boutique). This experience is required. Candidates whose ERP experience has been exclusively in-house at a single employer will not be a fit for this role. Enterprise ERP experience: 5–8 years of experience working with a major enterprise ERP platform such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, Dynamics, or NetSuite. Implementation experience: At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, with hands-on involvement across requirements, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support. Functional expertise: Strong functional knowledge in SCM-adjacent areas such as inventory, order management, procurement, costing, or planning. Integration experience: Familiarity with REST/SOAP APIs, third-party system connections, and data migration, with an understanding of how ERP systems connect with the broader technology environment. Written communication: You can produce clear, useful documentation, status reports, and issue summaries that help nontechnical stakeholders understand what’s happening and what needs to happen next. Preferred skills: Experience presenting to steering committees, executive sponsors, or client leadership Experience working across multiple industries and client environments Experience automating support or testing workflows Familiarity with reporting and analytics tools, including BI and embedded ERP analytics

review_candidates.description: About Heaviside Industries Heaviside Industries builds multi-domain autonomous precision munitions for U.S. and allied special operations and conventional forces. While modern warfare has rapidly evolved with the proliferation of unmanned systems, hyper-precise munitions in contested environments are the future of the battlefield. Economical precision strike capabilities are critical to U.S. and allied war efforts, enabling successful defeat of enemy military assets and infrastructure. Heaviside builds precision munitions designed to operate in GPS-denied and spectrum-jammed battlefields—where traditional systems degrade or fail—without inflated prices or sacrifice to performance. All engineering and manufacturing is conducted in-house in Heaviside's Los Angeles, CA headquarters and Oslo, Norway office. Heaviside is backed by Interlagos, Menlo Ventures, Flume Ventures, Cantos, Anorak Ventures, and Ravelin Ventures. What You Will Do Own the full BD lifecycle for Middle East accounts: opportunity identification, relationship development, capture planning, proposal support, and award—across Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Direct Commercial Sales (DCS), and partner-nation direct channels Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of Middle East programs aligned to Heaviside's current and emerging product lines, with emphasis on UAS, loitering munitions, and EW/SIGINT requirements Cultivate direct relationships with partner-nation MoD acquisition officials, program offices, and end users across the Gulf (UAE, embassy country teams, and defense attachés to develop demand signal, advocacy, and coalition interoperability positioning Lead DCS pursuits end to end, coordinating export licensing strategy (DSP-5, TAA/MLA), technology release, and policy review timelines with legal and compliance Represent Heaviside at regional exhibitions and engagements, including IDEX/NAVDEX, Dubai Airshow, World Defense Show, DIMDEX, and SOFEX Identify, vet, and manage in-country representatives, consultants, and teaming partners in strict compliance with FCPA and ITAR Part 130 reporting requirements Maintain in-country assembly expectations Provide ongoing market intelligence on competitor positioning, emerging regional requirements, and technology whitespace What We Are Looking For 10+ years of experience in defense business development, international program management, or security cooperation—with a demonstrable focus on Middle East customers Prior U.S. military service, security cooperation tours (SCO/OMC), or CENTCOM staff experience strongly preferred; field-grade officer or senior NCO background a significant plus Existing relationships across Gulf ministries of defense, propositions for partner-nation customers Ability to travel 40–50%, including extended international travel to the region Active Secret clearance required [BONUS] Background in UAS, loitering review_candidates.title: Account Executive, APAC
review_candidates.description: About Aaru Aaru operates at the bleeding edge of predictive intelligence, using AI to simulate and predict human behavior at scale. By generating and deploying instances of artificial intelligence that mirror humans, called agents, Aaru simulates entire populations with unprecedented accuracy. Our partners use Aaru to refine strategic positioning, identify and understand high-value audiences, validate concepts and messaging before launch, optimize pricing decisions, and build a continuously richer understanding of their customers through simulation. We provide organizations with invaluable foresight, empowering them to anticipate outcomes and proactively make the right decisions at the right time, every time. We're a small, dedicated, mission-driven team and we intend to stay that way. We believe the best work happens when exceptionally talented people are given ownership, trust and the space to operate without bureaucratic friction. We work with urgency and intellectual honesty and expect new team members to match our velocity. We seek individuals who thrive at the frontier, who push beyond conventional limits, who bring curiosity and conviction in equal measure, and who want their work to have demonstrable impact in the world. If you're energized by the idea of a small team doing things that feel impossible, let’s build together. About The Role Aaru is looking for an Account Executive to help drive our go to market. Aaru's clients use behavioral simulations to pressure-test high-stakes decisions before they're made: M&A strategy, product launches, policy shifts, and geopolitical risk assessments. You are selling a novel capability to some of the world’s most sophisticated decision-makers, including C-suite executives and government officials. The ideal candidate has done this before. You have sold a technically sophisticated or emerging-category product into enterprise accounts and run deals to close without needing to be managed to the finish line. Responsibilities Own the full sales cycle, end-to-end. Drive prospecting, discovery, scoping, pitching, negotiation, and close. You are accountable for pipeline quality, deal velocity, and revenue. Develop and execute highly targeted outbound strategies to identify and engage prospective customers across functions such as strategy, innovation, insights, marketing, and exec leadership. Run rigorous discovery processes that uncover high-value use cases, diagnose customer pain points, and translate Aaru’s capabilities into clear business outcomes. Manage multi-threaded, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Navigate complex organizations with multiple buyers and tailor your communication for each audience. Spearhead market expansion by identifying new customer segments, verticals, and use cases where Aaru’s simulation capabilities can deliver immediate and compounding value. Help refine Aaru’s go-to-market motion by providing structured market feedback on positioning, objections, pricing, and repeatable sales plays. Build the playbook by documenting what works. Maintain clear pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and account plans, using CRM data and customer signals to drive disciplined execution and continuous improvement. YOU MAY BE A FIT IF You have 5/7 years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic sales, or founding AE roles, ideally selling a complex, high-value or AI product into sophisticated customers. You know how to sell outcomes rather than features, and can connect what a product does to what a buyer cares about. You are able to build a compelling ROI narrative and make it credible to a skeptical executive audience. You are comfortable building pipeline from scratch and creating opportunities through thoughtful, high-conviction outbound rather than relying on inbound demand. You are strong in consultative, multi-stakeholder sales and know how to navigate executive buyers, ambiguous use cases, and non-obvious value propositions. You write and communicate with precision, and can produce executive-ready proposals, and customer-facing materials that are sharp, concise, and effective without heavy guidance. You have experience in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where the product, category, and sales motion are still being defined in real time. You operate with urgency, and hold a high bar for preparation, client communication, and follow-through. STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO Have experience selling through consulting or channel partners, not just direct, and understand the nuances of co-selling and partner-influenced deals. Have sold something that didn't have a name yet: a new category, a new methodology, a capability that buyers had to be educated on before they could be convinced. Have familiarity with financial services, CPG, energy, healthcare, or government verticals where high-stakes decisions are frequent and the cost of being wrong is high. Have exposure to AI, advanced analytics, research methodologies, or scenario planning tools, and can have a substantive conversation about how they work and where they fall short. Have a background in traditional market research and consumer insights (e.g., survey design, focus groups, quantitative/qualitative analysis, syndicated data sources) with a strong foundation in translating research findings into actionable business recommendations LOCATION This role is based in Singapore. Aaru is an in-person company, working 5 days a week in office. Candidates are expected to be located within the country or open to relocation. Benefits At Aaru, we take care of our people. In addition to a competitive base salary and equity participation, we offer comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, visa sponsorship and relocation support, and various other benefits and perks.

new_matches.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位：储能项目投资分析师/经理 地点：苏州，中国 职位概述 揽海新能源(Mars Renewable)是一家面向欧洲市场的储能(BESS)企业，业务正向资产端开发(asset origination)延伸。作为储能项目投资分析师，你将是公司海外储能项目投资决策的量化核心——搭建和运营项目财务模型，评估欧洲各国储能项目的收益与风险(电价、辅助服务、容量机制、政策监管)，支持项目筛选、尽职调查与投资决策全流程。你的分析将直接决定公司在欧洲数亿级资产的投向，与业务开发、法务、交付团队紧密协作，并接触一线欧洲市场数据。 职责 一、财务建模与收益测算 搭建并维护储能项目全生命周期财务模型(DCF / IRR / NPV / 回收期)，涵盖收入侧(能量套利、辅助服务、容量费用、PPA)与成本侧(CAPEX / OPEX / 税费 / 融资成本) 对电价曲线、循环次数、衰减率、辅助服务价格等关键变量进行敏感性分析与情景模拟 二、市场与政策研究 跟踪欧洲主要市场(英、德、意、西、荷等)的电价走势、批发电价与平衡机制、容量市场/容量费政策及各国储能收入机制演变 研究各国监管框架对储能资产收益的影响(电网费率、双重收费豁免、拍卖机制等)，输出市场进入优先级建议 三、项目筛选与尽调支持 对潜在储能项目/资产标的进行初步筛选与收益初评，输出投资评级建议 支持项目尽职调查：审阅收入合同(PPA / 容量协议 / 辅助服务合同)、技术参数(可用率、循环寿命)、并网与许可条件，识别收益实现风险 四、投资决策支持 撰写投资分析报告、投资备忘录与董事会汇报材料，清晰呈现收益逻辑、风险与缓释措施 参与投资决策会议，对模型假设与测算结果进行答辩 五、投后跟踪与模型校准 跟踪已投项目实际运行数据与收益兑现情况，校准模型假设，输出偏差分析与经验沉淀 支持资产退出(转让)时的估值测算与买方沟通材料 六、其他 完成公司安排的其他工作 任职要求 硬性门槛(必需) 本科及以上学历，金融、经济、电气工程、能源、数学等相关专业 3–6 年投资分析、项目融资、财务建模或能源行业研究经验 能独立从零搭建项目财务模型(Excel 高级运用：情景/敏感性/蒙特卡洛加分) 熟悉项目投资评价指标体系(IRR / NPV / DSCR / 回收期)及其金融逻辑 专业能力 理解电力市场基本逻辑：批发电价、峰谷价差、辅助服务、容量机制；对至少一个欧洲电力市场有认知 具备较强的数据获取与处理能力(电价数据、市场报告、公开数据库) 报告撰写与呈现能力强，能把复杂测算讲给非金融背景的管理层听懂 素质要求 好奇心强、自驱，愿意深挖市场与政策细节 严谨、对数字敏感，敢于挑战业务端的乐观假设 能适应多任务并行与快节奏决策环境 加分项 有欧洲电力市场/储能项目投资分析经验(尤其在英国、德国、意大利市场) 熟悉储能技术参数与运行逻辑(循环寿命、效率、衰减)对收益的影响，或有 BESS 技术背景 有投行、基金、咨询(能源组)或电力公司战略/投资部门背景 会使用 Python / PLEXOS / Envision 等分析工具，或有蒙特卡洛/优化建模经验 英语可作为工作语言(阅读欧洲市场报告、与外部顾问沟通)

Nossa história é movida por dedicação, inovação e pelo propósito de fazer a diferença não só no mercado, mas na vida das pessoas. Somos uma organização de múltiplos segmentos, com atuação relevante em combustíveis, serviços financeiros, construção civil e produção de alimentos, sempre com foco em crescimento sustentável e valor para a sociedade. Conheça mais sobre o Grupo FAN em https://grupofan.com PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES: Supervisão de Equipe: Supervisionar, orientar e acompanhar a equipe de qualidade do produto nas rotinas diárias de controle de qualidade nas obras. Acompanhamento Preventivo: Atuar diretamente no canteiro de obras, acompanhando a execução dos serviços em tempo real para prevenir desvios e assegurar o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos. Conferência de Serviços: Apoiar e supervisionar a liberação e conferência dos serviços executados, verificando conformidade com projetos, procedimentos e especificações técnicas. Monitoramento de Indicadores: Acompanhar indicadores e registros da área de qualidade, contribuindo com análises e ações de melhoria contínua. Conformidade Técnica: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, procedimentos internos e diretrizes da construtora nas frentes de trabalho. Atuação na Solução de Problemas : Identificar de forma antecipada possíveis falhas construtivas, apoiando a equipe de produção na correção dos métodos executivos sempre que necessário. Experiência comprovada e sólida atuação em obras (produção e/ou qualidade). Conhecimento técnico sobre método construtivo Parede de Concreto. Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas técnicos complexos. Desejáveis (Diferenciais): Pós-graduação ou especialização em Patologia das Construções. new_matches.title: Senior Project Accountant, Generation Development
new_matches.description: About us: Founded in 1990, LS Power is a premier development, investment, and operating company focused on the North American power and energy infrastructure sector, with leading platforms across generation, transmission and energy expansion solutions. Since inception, LS Power has developed or acquired 50,000 MW of power generation, including utility-scale solar, wind, hydro, battery energy storage, and natural gas-fired facilities. Through its transmission business, LS Power Grid, the company built and operates 780+ miles of high-voltage transmission and 7 transmission utilities and has another 375+ miles currently in construction or development. LS Power actively invests in and scales businesses that are meeting the growing needs of the energy expansion, including electric vehicle charging, demand response, microgrids, renewable fuels and waste-to-energy platforms. Over the years, LS Power has raised more than $89 billion in debt and equity capital to support North American infrastructure. Our Purpose, Mission, & Values: Our Purpose is to solve complex energy problems that improve the world Our Mission is to make lives better by developing a cleaner and more reliable energy ecosystem Our Values are the willingness to participate in and help strengthen our culture of integrity, Innovation, Teamwork, and Taking Ownership Our People create value and are our Most Valuable asset. We take our values of Integrity, Innovation, Teamwork and Taking Ownership seriously and ask candidates to think about how they can help us further enhance our culture with their specific skillsets, capabilities and experiences. Benefits We provide our team the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and continue in their career growth. We are committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits that include 100% employer paid premium healthcare, paid parental leave and more. Compensation The salary for this role is $82,000 - $100,000. This is the range that we in good faith anticipate relying on when setting wages for this position. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and this range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in New Jersey. This salary range may also be modified in the future. About the Role: LS Power is seeking a Senior Project Accountant to join its growing Generation Development Accounting team. As the generation development portfolio expands, so does the volume, complexity, and financial risk of capital project activity. This role maintains the financial visibility and control senior management requires as projects move from early-stage development through construction and into service. The Senior Project Accountant is the primary financial partner to project management and development teams, ensuring every dollar of capital spend is accurately tracked, properly coded, and clearly reported across the project lifecycle. The role goes beyond recording transactions. It means flagging budget variances before they escalate, challenging cost classifications before they hit the ledger, and delivering the financial discipline that supports confident decision-making at the executive level. Deep proficiency in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Management module and a demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered tools to streamline reporting and surface insights faster are essential. Responsibilities What You Will Do Project Accounting & Month-End Close Own end-to-end project accounting for active generation development projects, serving as the primary contact for project cost information for internal and external stakeholders. Maintain project cost structures in the D365 Project Management module so that work orders, purchase orders, and contract commitments are reflected accurately and in real time. Coordinate with AP, procurement, and project development teams on accurate capital coding and timely cost capture in the general ledger, and resolve coding disputes to prevent month-end backlogs. Review requisitions and purchase orders through the approval workflow, confirming project coding and budget alignment before commitments are released. Review construction contract invoices against approved budgets, support the project team in maintaining change order logs, and track retainage balances across all active generation development projects. Proactively identify budget variances at the contract and work order level and communicate findings to project managers and senior management before variances compound. Manage month-end close, including recording actuals, determining accruals, posting audit-ready journal entries, and reconciling construction-in-progress (CWIP), AP accrual, and retainage balances. Monitor CWIP balances with project managers and fixed asset accounting to ensure timely plant-in-service transfers, on-schedule asset transfer packages, and proper cost componentization and classification at project completion. Support the broader accounting team with audit requests, special projects, and process improvement initiatives as they arise. Cash Flow Management & Financial Reporting Assist with monthly cash forecasting, maintaining a rolling 12-month forecast reflecting current project schedules, contract commitments, and funding requirements. Coordinate with project managers, treasury, and senior management to align cash forecasts with milestones and capital call schedules so funding precedes major expenditures. Monitor cash positions across project entities, prepare monthly cash summaries with variance explanations, and flag cash flow risk such as overruns, accelerated spend, or delayed recoveries well before liquidity is impacted. Build and maintain the monthly project spend report for leadership and investors using D365 data and AI-powered reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Copilot), with templates that pull cost data automatically and reduce manual preparation time. Tailor report formats and narratives to the audience, from executive dashboards to investor reporting packages that meet contractual requirements. Support budget preparation and monthly variance analysis, developing bottom-up capital budgets with project managers and preparing explanations that distinguish timing differences from scope changes and true overruns. Complete monthly and quarterly reporting required by individual project agreements, including investor reports, lender compliance packages, and project-level financial statements. Assist with quarterly and annual financial statement preparation and the annual audit, including audit schedules, auditor inquiries, and audit-ready project files maintained year-round. Support the annual capital budget process, coordinating with project managers to compile and review capital project budgets. Project Controls & Financial Integrity Act as the primary point of accountability for the accuracy of project cost data in D365, ensuring management reporting, investor reporting, and financial statements all draw from a single, reliable source of truth. Maintain and enforce project cost coding standards in D365 to prevent misclassification of operating costs as capital expenditures (or vice versa), and maintain a self-serve coding reference guide for project managers and AP staff. Conduct periodic audits of project cost transactions to identify miscoded items, duplicate charges, or unapproved commitments, and work with the relevant teams to resolve and prevent recurrence. Establish month-end review checklists and project close-out procedures that confirm all costs are captured, coded, and reconciled before reports are issued. Escalate control issues such as budget overruns, unauthorized commitments, or unusual cost patterns, and prepare a monthly project controls summary of open issues, corrective actions, and emerging risks. Support the tax teams and external tax advisors with project cost schedules, asset classification detail, and cost basis documentation segregated by asset type, jurisdiction, and tax treatment. Contribute to process improvement, documenting current-state processes and developing D365 workflows, automated controls, and reporting enhancements that increase efficiency and reduce error risk. Qualifications We Want You On Our Team Because You... Have strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting practices as applied to capital project and construction accounting, including cost capitalization, CWIP, and asset classification. Are proficient in Microsoft Dynamics 365, with the ability to navigate the Project Management module and extract, analyze, and report on project cost data with minimal support. Are familiar with procurement and payment management software, preferably D365 Procurement & Sourcing and IBM Maximo (others considered), including a solid understanding of requisition and purchase order approval workflows and how POs and invoices flow into the project ledger. Are comfortable using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Power BI to build spending reports, automate variance analysis, and present financial data to technical and non-technical audiences. Have strong Microsoft Excel skills, including modeling, pivot tables, and large data set management; Power Query and Fabric experience is a plus. Can manage multiple active projects simultaneously, meeting recurring deadlines while maintaining the attention to detail accurate reporting requires. Bring exceptional analytical and reasoning ability, with strong quantitative skills and the instinct to dig into variances and understand the “why” behind the numbers. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to present project financial status in management meetings, investor calls, and audit settings. Take a collaborative approach that builds strong relationships with project managers, AP, treasury, tax, and senior leadership, translating complex financial data into clear, actionable insight. Have a strong sense of ownership, surfacing issues before they escalate and operating with the integrity and professionalism LS Power's investors and partners expect. Ideally, You Have Bachelor's degree in Accounting; a master's degree or CPA designation is a plus. Minimum of four years of accounting experience, with meaningful exposure to capital project or construction accounting in an energy, power generation, or capital-intensive industry. Experience managing project accounting in a multi-entity environment with active capital development programs. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Project Management module) or a comparable ERP/project accounting system; configuring or maintaining project cost structures is a plus. Demonstrated experience with budget preparation, variance analysis, and cash flow forecasting for capital projects, and preparing financial reports for lenders and senior management
