new_matches.title: SVP, Finance (Infrastructure Construction)
new_matches.description: The Senior Vice President of Finance serves as the strategic financial leader for the Infrastructure business, driving financial performance, governance, and long-term growth across a diverse portfolio of operations. Reporting to the CE&I CFO, with a matrix relationship to the Infrastructure EVP, this role leads the finance organization through a team of VP-level leaders and provides executive oversight of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, accounting operations, reporting, and compliance. As a trusted business partner to senior leadership, the SVP plays a critical role in shaping strategy, optimizing performance, and supporting disciplined growth. Location: This role offers location flexibility and may be based anywhere within the Continental United States. Travel: Up to 50% travel is required to provide on-site leadership, strengthen business partnerships, and support operations across a geographically diverse Infrastructure organization. Company Overview MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates more than $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across our operating groups: Renewables, Industrial, Infrastructure and General Building. Our Renewables expertise includes solar, wind, energy storage, aftermarket services, substations and switchyards. Our Industrial expertise includes manufacturing, mining and mineral processing, power plants, conventional power generation, alternative fuel generation and other innovative solutions. In Infrastructure, we specialize in electrical, environmental, highways, roads and bridges, aggregate mining, ports and terminals, rail, pump and lift stations, water transmission and pipelines, water and wastewater treatment plants, and stormwater. Our General Building expertise includes airports, seaport terminals, sports and entertainment, pre-engineered metal buildings, and data centers. MasTec is a minority‑owned Fortune 500 construction company with more than 90 years of industry experience. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we deliver complex infrastructure projects across the country. Safety and sustainability are core to how we operate. MasTec is proudly ranked by Engineering News‑Record as #1 in Power, #16 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, and #13 Transportation Contractor. The Clean Energy & Infrastructure Group comprises the following market sectors and operating companies: Renewables: IEA Constructors, Wanzek Construction, White Construction; Industrial: Phoenix Industrial, MasTec Industrial; Infrastructure: American Civil Constructors West Coast, Cash Construction, FNF Construction, MasTec Civil, McKee Utility Contractors, Precision Aggregate Products, Ragnar Benson Construction, Saiia Construction, William Charles Construction, William Charles Electric; General Building: Lemartec, NV2A. Responsibilities Strategic & Executive Leadership Serve as a core member of the CE&I finance leadership team. Participate in I&I Group strategy development and execution. Provide financial insights to drive disciplined capital allocation and business performance. Partner closely with operational leaders to improve financial transparency and accountability. Financial Management & Reporting Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, forecasting, and operating reviews. Oversee timely and accurate internal and external financial reporting. Ensure proper implementation of accounting policies and evolving internal controls. Maintain compliance with SOX and technical accounting standards. Oversee revenue recognition processes, particularly percentage-of-completion accounting for construction contracts. Project Controls & Risk Management Drive rigorous project financial management and risk mitigation processes. Enhance visibility into job-level profitability, cost controls, and margin performance. Support bid reviews and pricing decisions to improve win quality and risk-adjusted returns. Finance Operations & Transformation Lead finance operations across Infrastrtucture, focusing on process redesign and continuous improvement. Evaluate and deploy ERP systems and business enablement software solutions. Implement scalable systems and controls suitable for a rapidly expanding platform. Oversee integration of finance teams, systems, and processes following acquisitions. Talent & Organizational Development Develop strategic talent planning initiatives in partnership with HR. Mentor and coach high-performing finance leaders across business units. Build strong succession plans across all key finance roles. Foster a culture of integrity, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement. In The First 12 Months, The Successful Candidate Will Establish credibility with Infrastructure operational leaders and CE&I executive leadership. Develop a comprehensive understanding of project economics, systems, and reporting structures. Identify and prioritize critical finance transformation and integration initiatives. Improve forecasting reliability and project margin visibility. Strengthen internal controls and reporting consistency across legacy platforms. Provide leadership specific to change management on processes and ERP consolidation. Elevate talent capabilities and build a cohesive finance organization across acquired entities. Qualifications Work Experience and Education 10+ years of senior financial management experience in a large, geographically dispersed Infrastructure EPC or industrial organization. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business CPA or CA designation preferred Experience within a large, publicly traded organization strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Take reasonable care of your own and others’ health and safety and of those who may be affected by the day-to-day delivery of this role by taking personal responsibility for working toward the Company’s Zero Injury principles Demonstrated success leading high-performing finance teams in complex, publicly traded and growth-oriented environments. Experience overseeing Joint Venture operations, project-based accounting, and percentage-of-completion revenue recognition. Proven track record leading finance transformation initiatives, ERP implementations, and post-acquisition finance integrations. new_matches.title: Analista de Performance de Marketing
new_matches.description: Sobre nós A FIT Energia, uma empresa do grupo Santander, é uma plataforma de geração distribuída com presença em todo o território nacional, conectando geradores e consumidores de energia. Nosso objetivo é viabilizar e promover o consumo de energia limpa e mais acessível para todos. Descrição da vaga Buscamos um(a) Analista de Performance de Marketing para integrar o time de Marketing da FIT Energia. Essa pessoa será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar estratégias de marketing de performance em múltiplos canais digitais, com foco em escalabilidade, geração de resultados e maximização do ROI. Responsabilidades e atribuições Planejar e operar campanhas de tráfego pago. Gerenciar campanhas full-funnel, do setup à otimização pós-conversão. Configurar e auditar pixels, eventos de conversão e tracking via GTM/Server-Side Tagging. Garantir integridade dos dados para tomadas de decisão precisas. Desenvolver estratégias de SEO on-page e off-page, com foco em performance e autoridade de domínio. Realizar auditorias técnicas e acompanhar rankings, palavras-chave e evolução de tráfego. Estruturar e gerenciar programas de afiliados e influenciadores, com foco em performance mensurável. Criar dashboards e relatórios executivos que conectem métricas de marketing à geração de receita. Acompanhar KPIs críticos (CAC, LTV, ROAS, ativação) e gerar insights estratégicos de alto impacto. Requisitos e qualificações Graduação em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em mídia paga multicanal, gestão de budgets e metas de ROAS/CAC. Vivência com CRO, ferramentas de otimização. Conhecimento avançado em SEO técnico, conteúdo e link building. Domínio de Web Analytics e ferramentas de data visualization. Aqui na FIT Energia, acreditamos que pessoas movem resultados. Por isso, nossos benefícios foram pensados para trazer mais qualidade de vida, bem-estar e equilíbrio para quem cresce com a gente todos os dias. Praticidade na sua rotina Vale Refeição/Alimentação - Benefício pensado para trazer mais conforto e praticidade para o seu dia a dia Auxílio Mobilidade Flexível - O valor é calculado conforme sua necessidade de deslocamento e disponibilizado em um cartão flexível, que pode ser utilizado como Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível. Day Off no mês do aniversário - Porque celebrar a sua história também faz parte do jeito FIT de fazer. Economia na Conta de Energia - Um benefício que conecta você ainda mais ao nosso propósito. Saúde e bem-estar Plano de Saúde SulAmérica - Cobertura nacional na modalidade apartamento, com coparticipação, para cuidar de você em todos os momentos. Assistência Odontológica - Mais tranquilidade e cuidado para o seu bem-estar. Seguro de Vida - Segurança e suporte para você e sua família. Gympass | Wellhub - Acesso gratuito aos planos Starter e Basic para incentivar saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Desconto em Plano de Saúde Pet - Porque cuidar de quem faz parte da sua família também importa. Desenvolvimento e experiências Parcerias com Universidades - Descontos e oportunidades para apoiar seu crescimento profissional. Desconto em Cursos de Idiomas - Porque evoluir também é ampliar conexões. Plataforma Interna de Desenvolvimento - Acesso a cursos, conteúdos e trilhas de aprendizado para apoiar seu aprimoramento contínuo e desenvolvimento de carreira. Plataforma de benefícios gastronômicos - Um app que reune gastronomia e economia para aproveitar ainda mais seus momentos Clube de Compras - Descontos e vantagens especiais em diversos produtos e serviços. Aqui, cuidar das pessoas, incentivar o desenvolvimento e construir relações próximas faz parte do nosso DNA. Esse é o jeito FIT de fazer. Informações Adicionais Informamos que, para garantir maior controle e agilidade em nosso processo seletivo, todas as vagas serão gerenciadas diretamente nas plataformas em que são divulgadas. Não responderemos a candidatos por mensagens privadas no LinkedIn, exceto em casos de recrutamento ativo (hunting). Todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas diversas em identidade de gênero, cor e etnia, orientação sexual, origem e pessoas com deficiência (PcD). #VEMPRAFIT

new_matches.description: About this role: The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings. Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients. In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$1bil in annual revenue. In our Tech Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have +$500mil in annual revenue. What you will do: Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services Identify, cultivate, qualify and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met. Quota responsibility for your assigned territory. Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments. Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis. What you will need: 5-8+ years' B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets. Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process. Willingness to conduct travel as needed. Bachelor's degree preferred What you will get: Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more! Uncapped commission structure World-class sales training programs and skill development programs Annual “Winners Circle” event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion Professional development and career growth opportunities Who are we? At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. Gartner is the world authority on AI At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. What do we offer? Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us. new_matches.title: 运营经理/总监
new_matches.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 一、岗位职责 1. 经营计划与目标管理 主导公司年度/季度/月度经营计划、预算及KPI体系的制定、分解与落地； 建立计划跟踪机制，定期复盘经营指标完成情况，识别偏差并推动纠偏； 统筹各部门资源排布，确保战略目标在营销端和交付端同步对齐。 2. 营销全周期运营管理（市场 → 线索 → 商机 → 成交） 统筹营销体系的运营节奏，覆盖市场策划、品牌推广、线索获取、商机培育、投标支持、合同签订等全链路； 建立营销漏斗数据监控体系，跟踪线索转化率、商机推进效率、成交周期等核心指标； 协同市场、销售部门优化获客策略与销售流程，推动销售目标达成； 组织重大营销项目的统筹管理（如行业展会、大客户攻坚、新品发布等），确保关键节点按期交付。 3. 交付全周期运营管理（立项 → 实施 → 验收 → 回款 → 客户成功） 统筹交付体系运营，覆盖项目启动、方案实施、里程碑管控、客户验收、回款跟进、售后服务等全生命周期； 建立交付项目进度跟踪机制，定期输出项目健康度报告，预警延期、成本超支、质量偏差等风险； 推动交付标准化建设，优化项目交付流程、SOP及工具模板，提升交付效率与客户满意度； 协同交付、技术、供应链等部门，解决项目推进中的资源瓶颈与跨部门协作问题； 跟踪项目回款节点，推动应收账款按期回收，保障现金流健康。 4. 全公司AR项跟进与会议决议闭环 建立公司级AR（Action Item）管理机制，统筹各部门待办事项的收集、分配、跟踪与闭环验收； 负责公司各类经营会议（如经营分析会、项目协调会、专题复盘会）的决议事项跟进，确保决议落地执行； 定期输出AR执行进度报告，对逾期事项进行预警并推动责任部门整改； 推动公司执行力文化建设，确保"事事有回音、件件有着落"。 5. 项目进度统筹与风险管控 建立公司级项目管理体系（PMO），对重点营销项目和交付项目实行统一立项、分级管控； 组织项目例会、专题协调会及复盘会，确保信息透明、问题闭环、经验沉淀； 识别项目全周期中的关键风险，制定应对预案并推动落地。 6. 数据运营与流程优化 搭建覆盖"营销-交付"全链路的数据看板，实现经营数据可视化； 定期输出运营分析报告，为管理层提供决策支持； 梳理并优化LTC（Lead to Cash）核心业务流程，识别低效环节并推动改进，提升端到端运营效率。 二、任职要求 基本条件 学历要求：一类本科及以上学历，硕士优先； 专业背景：工商管理、项目管理、市场营销、经济学、理工科等相关专业； 工作经验： 运营经理：5年以上运营/项目管理经验，具备营销或交付端运营管理背景； 运营总监：8年以上经验，3年以上团队管理经验，有完整"营销+交付"双端运营操盘经历。 核心能力 全周期运营能力：熟悉B2B/解决方案型业务的营销全周期（获客→成交）和交付全周期（实施→回款→客户成功），有LTC流程管理经验优先； 计划与项目管理能力：精通经营计划编制与落地，熟悉PMBOK/敏捷等项目管理方法论，持有PMP认证者优先； AR跟进与执行力：具备公司级待办事项和会议决议的跟踪闭环经验，推动力强，能确保组织执行力落地； 进度管控能力：具备较强的项目跟踪、风险识别与问题解决能力，能推动复杂项目按期交付并回款； 数据驱动意识：具备经营数据分析能力，熟练使用项目管理工具（如Jira、飞书项目、Teambition）及数据分析工具； 跨部门协同能力：优秀的沟通协调能力，能有效整合市场、销售、交付、技术、财务等多方资源； 抗压与执行力：目标导向，责任心强，能在多线程高压环境下推动结果达成。

Written communication: You can produce clear, useful documentation, status reports, and issue summaries that help nontechnical stakeholders understand what’s happening and what needs to happen next. new_matches.title: Account Executive, APAC
new_matches.description: About Aaru Aaru operates at the bleeding edge of predictive intelligence, using AI to simulate and predict human behavior at scale. By generating and deploying instances of artificial intelligence that mirror humans, called agents, Aaru simulates entire populations with unprecedented accuracy. Our partners use Aaru to refine strategic positioning, identify and understand high-value audiences, validate concepts and messaging before launch, optimize pricing decisions, and build a continuously richer understanding of their customers through simulation. We provide organizations with invaluable foresight, empowering them to anticipate outcomes and proactively make the right decisions at the right time, every time. We're a small, dedicated, mission-driven team and we intend to stay that way. We believe the best work happens when exceptionally talented people are given ownership, trust and the space to operate without bureaucratic friction. We work with urgency and intellectual honesty and expect new team members to match our velocity. We seek individuals who thrive at the frontier, who push beyond conventional limits, who bring curiosity and conviction in equal measure, and who want their work to have demonstrable impact in the world. If you're energized by the idea of a small team doing things that feel impossible, let’s build together. About The Role Aaru is looking for an Account Executive to help drive our go to market. Aaru's clients use behavioral simulations to pressure-test high-stakes decisions before they're made: M&A strategy, product launches, policy shifts, and geopolitical risk assessments. You are selling a novel capability to some of the world’s most sophisticated decision-makers, including C-suite executives and government officials. The ideal candidate has done this before. You have sold a technically sophisticated or emerging-category product into enterprise accounts and run deals to close without needing to be managed to the finish line. Responsibilities Own the full sales cycle, end-to-end. Drive prospecting, discovery, scoping, pitching, negotiation, and close. You are accountable for pipeline quality, deal velocity, and revenue. Develop and execute highly targeted outbound strategies to identify and engage prospective customers across functions such as strategy, innovation, insights, marketing, and exec leadership. Run rigorous discovery processes that uncover high-value use cases, diagnose customer pain points, and translate Aaru’s capabilities into clear business outcomes. Manage multi-threaded, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Navigate complex organizations with multiple buyers and tailor your communication for each audience. Spearhead market expansion by identifying new customer segments, verticals, and use cases where Aaru’s simulation capabilities can deliver immediate and compounding value. Help refine Aaru’s go-to-market motion by providing structured market feedback on positioning, objections, pricing, and repeatable sales plays. Build the playbook by documenting what works. Maintain clear pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and account plans, using CRM data and customer signals to drive disciplined execution and continuous improvement. YOU MAY BE A FIT IF You have 5/7 years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic sales, or founding AE roles, ideally selling a complex, high-value or AI product into sophisticated customers. You know how to sell outcomes rather than features, and can connect what a product does to what a buyer cares about. You are able to build a compelling ROI narrative and make it credible to a skeptical executive audience. You are comfortable building pipeline from scratch and creating opportunities through thoughtful, high-conviction outbound rather than relying on inbound demand. You are strong in consultative, multi-stakeholder sales and know how to navigate executive buyers, ambiguous use cases, and non-obvious value propositions. You write and communicate with precision, and can produce executive-ready proposals, and customer-facing materials that are sharp, concise, and effective without heavy guidance. You have experience in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where the product, category, and sales motion are still being defined in real time. You operate with urgency, and hold a high bar for preparation, client communication, and follow-through. STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO Have experience selling through consulting or channel partners, not just direct, and understand the nuances of co-selling and partner-influenced deals. Have sold something that didn't have a name yet: a new category, a new methodology, a capability that buyers had to be educated on before they could be convinced. Have familiarity with financial services, CPG, energy, healthcare, or government verticals where high-stakes decisions are frequent and the cost of being wrong is high. Have exposure to AI, advanced analytics, research methodologies, or scenario planning tools, and can have a substantive conversation about how they work and where they fall short. Have a background in traditional market research and consumer insights (e.g., survey design, focus groups, quantitative/qualitative analysis, syndicated data sources) with a strong foundation in translating research findings into actionable business recommendations LOCATION This role is based in Singapore. Aaru is an in-person company, working 5 days a week in office. Candidates are expected to be located within the country or open to relocation. Benefits At Aaru, we take care of our people. In addition to a competitive base salary and equity participation, we offer comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, visa sponsorship and relocation support, and various other benefits and perks.
